module: Data module for genericGauges: computes fuel consumption (l/100 km), consumption display, power and torque of combustion engines and remaining range. Computations are only done for the requested properties.
notes: The instantaneous consumption comes from the variation of electrics.values.fuelVolume divided by dt*wheelspeed, bounded to 0..50 l/100 km; the average is smoothed over ~10 minutes and initialized to 10 l/100 km.
Power = sum of outputTorque1 * outputAV1 of the "combustionEngine" devices, converted to hp (W * 0.001 * 1.35962). The vehicle is considered moving above 0.5 m/s (wheelspeed).
setupGaugeData adds each engine's tanks to fuelTanks without clearing the list: a second call duplicates them.
updateGaugeData reads electrics.values.wheelspeed without a default value: Lua error if nil.

init.desc: Initializes the smoothed average consumption to 10 l/100 km.

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: fuelConsumption (averageFuelConsumption, currentFuelConsumption), fuelDisplay (fuelDisplay, -1..3), currentPower (currentPower and averagePower in hp, currentTorque in N·m), remainingRange (remainingRange; also enables fuelConsumption).

properties.desc: Set of requested properties (key = name, value = true).

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
